question: (3)/(20) is what percentage of (12)/(25)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required percentage = (First Fraction ÷ Second Fraction) × 100

⇒ (3/20 ÷ 12/25) × 100

⇒ (3/20 × 25/12) × 100 = (1/4 × 5/4) × 100 = 5/16 × 100

⇒ 5 × 6.25% = 31.25%

**∴ The correct answer is 31.25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First value = 3/20

Second value (Base) = 12/25

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Value / Base) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73159178d5f769f135bd1878f2a6d4a960c697c903fc6184767d575d0960c778.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Required Percentage = [(3/20) / (12/25)] × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (3/20 × 25/12) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (3 × 25 × 100) / (20 × 12)

⇒ Required Percentage = (7500) / (240)

⇒ Required Percentage = 750 / 24

⇒ Required Percentage = 31.25%

**∴ The correct answer is 31.25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

To convert any fraction a/b to a percentage, multiply the fraction by 100 and add the % sign.

Percentage of One Value w.r.t Another

To find what percent x is of y, use the formula: (x/y) × 100. Here, y is the **base value**.

Reciprocal Multiplication Rule

Dividing by a fraction is equivalent to multiplying by its reciprocal: (a/b) ÷ (c/d) = (a/b) × (d/c).</p
